display.title: Purim: In the Merit of the Children
display.summary_short: Why the Purim miracle happened in the merit of small children, and how children who learn Torah together today are the Jewish people's strongest weapon.
display.summary_long: A short pre-Purim talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that, as the Midrash teaches, the miracle of Purim came about in the merit of the very small children. When Haman's evil decree became known, Mordechai the tzaddik gathered 22,000 children into a large hall and taught them Torah, including the mitzvah of the Omer, strengthening their faith in Moshiach and the rebuilding of the Beis HaMikdash. The voice of Torah from pure young children is the ultimate weapon of the Jewish people. In the same way today, Tzivos Hashem gathers as many children as possible to learn Torah, give tzedakah, say the Twelve Pesukim and build good midos. Just as the Purim miracle came through children, the final Geulah will come in their merit, so they should keep up the good work and bring their friends along.
display.lesson: Gather together and learn Torah: the pure voices of children learning Torah bring miracles and the Geulah.
